gloss: condolence visit; call of condolence; visit of mourning

definitions.gloss: condolence visit; call of condolence; visit of mourning
definitions.explanation: A formal visit to a bereaved family to express condolences after someone's death. In Japan, a {弔問|ちょうもん} visitor may come to the family's home before the funeral or to the funeral venue itself to offer incense, prayers, and sympathy to the family of the deceased.

examples.japanese: {弔問|ちょうもん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{伺|うかが}う。
examples.english: To pay a visit of condolence.

examples.japanese: {弔問|ちょうもん}⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: Condolence visitors came one after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{故人|こじん}→故人：02807_kojin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ご{自宅|じたく}→ご自宅：24928_gojitaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{弔問|ちょうもん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{地味|じみ}→地味：01573_jimi⟧な⟦{服装|ふくそう}→服装：03594_fukusou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{伺|うかが}う。
examples.english: When making a condolence visit to the deceased's home, you should go in plain, subdued clothing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{通夜|つや}→通夜：16026_tsuya⟧や⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参列|さんれつ}→参列：11888_sanretsu⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{後日|ごじつ}→後日：12510_gojitsu⟧{弔問|ちょうもん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{伺|うかが}うこと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you cannot attend the wake or funeral, you may pay a condolence visit at a later date.

notes:
Formed from {弔|ちょう} (to mourn, to condole) + ⟦{問|もん}→〜問：04016_mon⟧ (to visit, to inquire). A formal term used in contexts of bereavement.

USAGE:
- Can be used as a suru-verb: {弔問|ちょうもん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to pay a condolence visit). The verb {伺|うかが}う is also common in the phrase {弔問|ちょうもん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{伺|うかが}う.
- Typical timing is either before the wake (⟦{通夜|つや}→通夜：16026_tsuya⟧) at the bereaved family's home, or after the funeral if the mourner could not attend in person.
- Visitors usually bring ⟦{香典|こうでん}→香典：06127_kouden⟧ (a monetary condolence offering) and wear subdued ⟦{略式|りゃくしき}→略式：13718_ryakushiki⟧⟦{喪服|もふく}→喪服：11898_mofuku⟧ (semi-formal mourning clothes) rather than the full black suit worn at the funeral itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弔問|ちょうもん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{伺|うかが}う: to go / call to pay condolences (humble form)
- {弔問|ちょうもん}⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧: a mourner calling to offer condolences
- {弔問|ちょうもん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧: to visit in condolence
- {弔問|ちょうもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive condolence visitors
- {弔問|ちょうもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧: letter of condolence

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{通夜|つや}→通夜：16026_tsuya⟧: wake — the evening gathering held before a funeral
- ⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧ / ⟦{葬式|そうしき}→葬式：04389_soushiki⟧: funeral ceremony
- ⟦{香典|こうでん}→香典：06127_kouden⟧: condolence money given at a funeral
- ⟦お{悔|く}やみ→お悔やみ：15866_okuyami⟧: expression of condolence — the words spoken or written
- ⟦{焼香|しょうこう}→焼香：16425_shoukou⟧: the burning of incense before the deceased's altar
